error_and_source_contracts.SVG_ANIM_DIAG_UNSUPPORTED_ELEMENT: UnsupportedElement at animation element name; unsupported animateColor is reported and omitted as in C.
error_and_source_contracts.SVG_ANIM_DIAG_UNSUPPORTED_TIMING: UnsupportedTiming at begin/end/repeatDur value offsets, the animation element name for invalid repeatCount, or unresolved sync ID offset; unresolved sync tracks become unsupported.
error_and_source_contracts.SVG_ANIM_DIAG_UNSUPPORTED_COMPOSITION: UnsupportedComposition at additive/accumulate attribute or element name where the C rule rejects composition.
error_and_source_contracts.SVG_ANIM_DIAG_UNSUPPORTED_PATH: UnsupportedPath at invalid d/motion path source span; incompatible d key reports that key's original span.
error_and_source_contracts.SVG_ANIM_DIAG_CSS_ANIMATION: CssAnimation at the source text token start when it contains @keyframes, animation:, or transition:; one ordered diagnostic per matching text token.
error_and_source_contracts.SVG_ANIM_DIAG_INVALID_TRACK: InvalidTrack at C-defined element/value offset; unsupported tracks are omitted while original source is retained.
error_and_source_contracts.hard track overflow: ParseError::TrackLimit carries the 129th candidate animation name offset; no partial Document is returned.
error_and_source_contracts.allocation failure: ParseError::Allocation from fallible parse reservations; evaluation's Option result is empty on reservation or evaluation failure; no simulated OOM is claimed.
error_and_source_contracts.source, spans, and ownership: Document borrows caller source for its lifetime and owns all arrays; every raw/source/target/element/id/sync span is a checked byte range into unchanged source. Evaluation does no source parsing or copying.
error_and_source_contracts.diagnostic cap/order: Diagnostics append in source traversal and track field order, stop at 128, and preserve byte offsets.

adaptations: Borrowed source lifetime replaces C's caller-managed source pointer lifetime; spans remain source byte offsets.
Rust Drop replaces explicit document/overlay destroy calls.
ParseError distinguishes track-cap exhaustion and fallible allocation; no allocator fault injection or simulated OOM is claimed.
Path command shape uses a fixed 1024-byte array; the C implementation's bounded stack arrays have the same observable cap.

invalid_base_value.legacy_contract: smil_tracks.c:183 records SVG_ANIM_DIAG_INVALID_TRACK at tag->name.offset when base_attribute_value rejects the target attribute.
invalid_base_value.rust_fix: parse.rs reports InvalidTrack at the animation element name when base_value returns None.
invalid_base_value.expected: No track; exactly one InvalidTrack diagnostic at the source offset of animate.

duplicate_mpath_ids.legacy_contract: motion_path.c counts every matching path id before accepting the unique target and d attribute.
duplicate_mpath_ids.rust_fix: motion.rs counts matching IDs independently of whether a match has a d attribute, then accepts only one match.
duplicate_mpath_ids.expected: No track; exactly one UnsupportedPath diagnostic at the source offset of animateMotion.

requested_behavior_regressions.expected: Checks absolute end timing, stored additive_sum/accumulate flags, iteration 1, additive sample 18, accumulation-only sample 9, and end-removed opacity state.
